image_type: new fixed VHD inside the guest only
larger_proof_harness_review: The first 512 MiB run hit the inherited 25-second small-proof deadline while performing write-through 64 KiB writes; its image and workers were removed. Use 1 MiB write-through blocks and a finite 90-second deadline for 512 MiB, retaining the same allocation-denial, exact capacity, privilege, outside-write and cleanup checks. The 32 MiB method remains unchanged.
required_checks: Bind the new image footer UUID, image path, associated non-system disk and partition before every storage mutation.
Reject the ordinary OS volume as the small capped filesystem.
Retain the existing allocation, outside-path, inherited descendant and interruption assertions unchanged.
AppContainer worker cannot write either owned outside sentinel directory.
Only the three preselected fresh package identities receive attached-device access; the backing-file ACL stays unchanged and worker write-open of that file returns access denied.
Guest service workers load native Python modules on an owned private window station; their elevation flag is zero.
Allocation fails with Windows disk-full error 39 or 112 before the selected 32/512 MiB capacity; removing payload restores free space.
Worker TEMP is inside its capped workspace; no alternate output directory is used.
Job termination retires the worker and releases its held file.
Hard controller termination retires its worker; its exact journal permits profile/junction recovery.
Detach and remove the owned image only after workers and profile mappings are retired.
Remove transfer/control scratch after retaining compact source-bound results.
